document.classification: engineering acceptance evidence; not statutory certification

decision.reason: Twenty-two engineering criteria have current or retained evidence: 16 current-campaign passes and 6 historical passes. DGM-T13 and DGM-T19 have approved current-release scope boundaries but remain not independently verified; the detailed T25 engineering contract is implemented, but DGM-T25 remains blocked pending owner approval and qualified professional confirmation of reserved statutory boundaries. The authoritative contract also keeps Composition, Unregistered, Consumer, UTGST, inclusive workflow, and other unsupported treatments blocked.

t25IntegrationBoundaries.boundary: Exact decimal values converted to JavaScript number
evidence: src/domain/services/gst-calculator.service.ts: persisted sales tax facts and line amounts
prisma/schema.prisma: invoice NUMERIC(14,2) and accepted/calculated purchase NUMERIC(20,4) fields
t25IntegrationBoundaries.finding: Three boundaries are distinct: (1) already-rounded two-decimal values such as 10.12 can serialize through Decimal.toNumber() to the expected number for that value, but this is not a universal losslessness guarantee; (2) arithmetic performed after conversion to JavaScript number retains binary floating-point behavior, demonstrated by 0.1 + 0.2; and (3) high-precision NUMERIC(20,4)-scale values can lose meaningful precision, demonstrated by 99999999999999.9999 becoming 100000000000000. The existing schemas coerce form strings through Number() before the shared Decimal path, and number-shaped service APIs remain.
Current invoice persistence and print output use two-decimal monetary representation. No e-invoice output surface exists in the current release.

t25IntegrationBoundaries.boundary: Invoice tax totals derived from reported item tax amounts
t25IntegrationBoundaries.finding: Sales totals aggregate line components; purchase finalization reconciles accepted line components to accepted invoice totals before posting. No e-invoice reconciliation output is implemented.

t25IntegrationBoundaries.boundary: Rule 35 inclusive extraction in production flow
t25IntegrationBoundaries.finding: The exact helper is focused-tested, while inclusive purchase creation/finalization remains fail-closed pending governed policy and workflow integration.
round_off is persisted separately and does not alter taxable values or GST components.
CGST, SGST, and IGST are calculated and persisted independently in supported paths. UTGST remains explicitly unsupported and is not a current-release implementation claim.

t25IntegrationBoundaries.boundary: Supplier-declared purchase values and issued sales invoice values
t25IntegrationBoundaries.finding: Purchase declared/calculated/accepted facts and raw source values remain separate; finalized sales values and tax/supply snapshots are persisted. This is not a new T25 database campaign.

No credit-note or debit-note calculation/workflow/model exists in the current release. The master specification lists credit/debit notes and returns as deferred product scope, but no explicit owner approval of a T25-12 current-release exclusion was found; therefore the boundary is classified as not implemented/no supported workflow, not as a verified pass, and no speculative subsystem was added.
